notes: 1 section header — too few for a contents list.

decisions.label: Remove the first section header
decisions.removes: State Board of Education Meeting Materials
decisions.why: "State Board of Education Meeting Materials" repeats the page title, so the reader is told the same thing twice before any content.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
decisions.value: Meeting agendas, exhibits, and minutes for the Maine State Board of Education. Workshop and business meetings are typically held monthly.

decisions.label: Let a long table be searched
decisions.why: 3 tables run to fifteen rows or more, so finding one row means reading every row. The theme already loads the search behaviour on every page and switches it on for any table marked this way — 26 tables across the site already are, including the contact directory. It adds a search box, a length menu and a pager, and makes the column headings sortable; ten rows show at a time, which is the library's own default. 3 of them open on the most recent row, because the first column is a date that sorts — the rest are left in the order they were written.
